result: Added a `@export_tool_button("Reset Health")` to `scripts/player.gd` that calls a new `reset_health()` (sets `health` to `max_health` and emits `health_changed`), and made the script `@tool` with an `Engine.is_editor_hint()` guard in `_physics_process` so the editor doesn't run the player's physics. Godot review reports no errors; I could not run the game.
